title: CalibShift — transfer to changed acquisition conditions

settings.protocol: leave one physical formulation out of every fitting/adaptation domain

reference_consistency.definition: within-formulation span <= atol + rtol * maximum absolute recorded reference

settings.method_availability: Target spectral recalibration is evaluated only for budgets >=4. Smaller budgets support correction only; unavailable choices are recorded in splits.csv.
settings.source_hash_definition: SHA256 of sorted relative Python paths and file bytes, each terminated by a NUL byte

original_source.title: Dataset on the Impact of Acquisition Temperature Variations on Quantitation Models of a Miniaturized NIR Spectrometer: A Platform for Calibration Transfer

provenance.transformations: 3141 spectra averaged within nine formulation IDs and four acquisition domains; 36 rows. No response-fitted preprocessing during preparation. Repeated scans are not independent formulations.

settings.input_hash_definition: SHA256 of parsed table serialized as canonical CSV; not original file bytes

diagnostics.question: Which measurement columns are incomplete or constant?
diagnostics.interpretation: Input-only descriptive audit; no feature is selected or removed using these summaries.

diagnostics.question: Are measurement features redundant?
diagnostics.interpretation: Pearson correlations of available row pairs, first 12 selected columns in input order; repeated rows are not independent evidence.

diagnostics.question: Which physical groups have the largest errors?
diagnostics.interpretation: One summary per method and physical group; group means and within-group RMSE are different quantities. No rows are excluded.

diagnostics.question: Does error vary across the measured response range?
diagnostics.interpretation: Up to four shared reference-quantile bins, determined after prediction for diagnosis only. Bin counts and group counts are retained; no uncertainty is inferred.

diagnostics.question: Does each method improve on its baseline using exactly the same observations?
diagnostics.interpretation: Descriptive paired comparisons; each method may have a different intersection. Differences do not supply independent confidence intervals or a global ranking.

diagnostics.question: Which held-out formulations lie beyond the selected standards' response range?
diagnostics.interpretation: Retrospective diagnostic uses the held-out reference only after fitting. It never changes standard selection or tuning.

capabilities.reason: Parsed rows and selected field availability are retained.
Available finite reference/comparison pairs; no missing reference is invented.

Required independence, variance, sample structure or prediction provenance is unavailable.

settings.evidence_summary: Exploratory results; selected uncertainty measures unavailable

notes: Spectra are averaged within each formulation and domain before evaluation. Responses must be consistent within each formulation.
The held-out formulation is absent from source training and target-domain standards. Components are selected by grouped CV within source training.
Standards are selected by evenly spaced source reference values among available training formulations; their held-out target errors are never used for selection.
A budget counts target-condition measurements of known standards, not automatically new laboratory reference assays. No domain-shift uncertainty guarantee is made.
Compare budgets on the same reported held-out formulation set. Different available standards can change coverage; correction can worsen performance.
evidence_status: Exploratory results; selected uncertainty measures unavailable
